title: Colombia magnitude 7.4 earthquake (7-34 AM, 10 August 2026)
caption: This seismogram is from the Santo Domingo seismic station in Venezuela. The noise is from a magnitude 7.4 earthquake in western Colombia. The quake hit at 7:34 AM, local time, on 10 August 2026. The epicenter was about 38 kilometers west-northwest of the town of Cartago, Colombia. The hypocenter was about 110 kilometers deep (below sea level). Shaking resulted from right-lateral slip along a west-northwest to east-southeast striking fault zone or left-lateral slip along a northeast-southwest striking fault zone. This is the tenth magnitude 7+ earthquakes of 2026. Summary from the United States
